title.narrative: Innovacion en la Infraestructura Escolar
Innovation in School Infrastructure

description.narrative: El objetivo de la operacin es contribuir a aumentar el acceso a la educacin a travs de infraestructura escolar innovadora y mejoras en la gestin escolar y curricular. Los objetivos especficos son contribuir a facilitar el aprendizaje de los alumnos a travs de: (i) mejoras y ampliacin de los espacios escolares con infraestructura innovadora; y (ii) creacin de un ambiente escolar que fomente el uso de prcticas pedaggicas centradas en los estudiantes utilizando espacios escolares innovadores y una gestin escolar que articule las reas curricular, pedaggica y administrativa. Se espera con esto contribuir a mejorar los aprendizajes de los alumnos.

The objective of the operation is to help increase access to education through innovative school infrastructure and improvements in school and curriculum management. The specific objectives are to help facilitate student achievement through: (i) innovative infrastructure to improve and expand school facilities; and (ii) the creation of a school environmental that fosters the use of student-centered teaching practices that use innovative school facilities and school management that coordinates the areas of curriculum, pedagogy, and administration. This is expected to help improve student achievement.
